# Frozen pre-merge evaluation records of PR 871 (CRW-951, twelve heads). The memory root is {MEMORY}; every program here is
# a Python program passed to python3.

=== PR871-01da262c-d1 | W
--why open bound by a for loop over a list.
python3 -c 'for f in [open]: f("{MEMORY}/n.md","w").write("x")'

=== PR871-01da262c-d1b | W
--why open bound as the default of a lambda parameter.
python3 -c '(lambda f=open: f("{MEMORY}/n.md","w").write("x"))()'

=== PR871-01da262c-d2 | W
--why io is rebound to a Path by a comprehension tuple target.
python3 -c 'import io; from pathlib import Path; [io.write_text("x") for (io,) in [(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"),)]]'

=== PR871-01da262c-d3 | B
--why A write to /w/n.md and the word memories in a string: no protected destination.
python3 -c 'import pathlib; pathlib.Path("/w/n.md").write_text("x"); print("memories")'

=== PR871-24f62ef3-d1 | W
--why Path.parent of memory-root/n.md/child is the protected n.md.
python3 -c 'import os as parent; from pathlib import Path; p = Path("{MEMORY}/n.md/child"); p.parent.write_text("x")'

=== PR871-24f62ef3-d2 | W
--why A raw bytes name with \N{foo} is literal filename text under the memory root.
python3 <<'PY'
m = rb"{MEMORY}/\N{foo}.md"
open(m, "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-24f62ef3-d3 | B | deviation=attempt/allow/allow
--why A read mode with a computed path is a read. The reader asks a grant for a read through an open() method on a receiver it cannot name (accepted over-refusal, fail closed).
python3 -c 'import io, os; (io).open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"), "r").read()'

=== PR871-24f62ef3-d4 | B
--why A dictionary key spelled memories is data.
python3 -c 'print({"memories": 1}.copy())'

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d1 | W
--why shutil bound to s: s.copy with a computed destination.
python3 -c 'import shutil, os; s = shutil; s.copy("/w/a", os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"))'

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d1b | W
--why A parenthesised attribute bound to f.
python3 -c 'import shutil, os; f = (shutil).copy; f("/w/a", os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"))'

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d2 | W
--why A stderr redirect before python3 and a here-document body.
python3 2>/dev/null <<'PY'
import os
open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"), "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d2b | W
--why The -c form with the redirect before the interpreter.
2>/dev/null python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; open(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"), "w").write("x")'

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d3 | W
--why A parameter named io shadows the module and receives a Path.
python3 <<'PY'
import io
from pathlib import Path
def put(io):
    io.open("w").write("x")
put(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"))
PY

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d4 | W
--why Carriage returns separate the statements inside the single-quoted program.
python3 -c 'import os{CR}m = "{MEMORY}/n.md"{CR}f = open{CR}f(m, "w").write("x")'

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d5 | B
--why A read through an f-string path with the default mode.
python3 -c 'root = "{MEMORY}"; print(open(f"{root}/n.md").read())'

=== PR871-6e106e5c-d5b | B
--why An explicit read mode.
python3 -c 'root = "{MEMORY}"; print(open(f"{root}/n.md", "r").read())'

=== PR871-76f0290e-d1 | W
--why A chained receiver with a computed mode str("w").
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; root = "{MEMORY}"; Path(root).joinpath("n.md").open(str("w")).write("x")'

=== PR871-76f0290e-d2 | W
--why A tuple target with two names rebinds io to the Path.
python3 -c 'import io; from pathlib import Path; [io.write_text("x") for io, unused in [(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"), 0)]]'

=== PR871-76f0290e-d3 | U
--why An unquoted here-document with a parameter: the program the shell hands over is unknown (criterion c1c), whatever the variable holds.
python3 <<PY
open("$OUT", "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-8148f7fb-d1 | W
--why An annotated assignment rebinds io to a Path.
python3 -c 'import io; from pathlib import Path; io: Path = Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); io.write_text("x")'

=== PR871-8148f7fb-d1b | W
--why A comprehension target rebinds io.
python3 -c 'import io; from pathlib import Path; [io.write_text("x") for io in [Path("{MEMORY}/n.md")]]'

=== PR871-8148f7fb-d2 | W
--why Argument unpacking supplies the destination.
python3 -c 'import shutil; s = shutil; args = ("/w/a", "{MEMORY}/n.md"); s.copy(*args)'

=== PR871-8148f7fb-d2b | W
--why Keyword unpacking supplies the destination.
python3 -c 'import shutil; s = shutil; s.copy(**{"src": "/w/a", "dst": "{MEMORY}/n.md"})'

=== PR871-8148f7fb-d3 | W
--why Criterion c1e: a write to a computed destination is an unknown destination and asks a grant; the finding wanted /w/n.md allowed because the raw label spells x6demories.
python3 -c 'import os; label = rf"/w/\x6demories/x"; open(os.path.join("/w", "n.md"), "w")'

=== PR871-8148f7fb-d5 | U
--why An unquoted here-document with a parameter.
python3 <<PY
open("$OUT", "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-90405376-d1 | W
--why A computed mode "w".strip() on a Path.open is a write.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); p.open("w".strip()).write("x")'

=== PR871-90405376-d1b | W
--why os.path.join("w") as the mode.
python3 -c 'import os; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); p.open(os.path.join("w")).write("x")'

=== PR871-90405376-d2 | W
--why open passed as a value to functools.partial with mode=.
python3 -c 'from functools import partial; m="{MEMORY}/n.md"; partial(open,m,mode="w")().write("x")'

=== PR871-90405376-d3 | W
--why Path.replace with an empty ** mapping.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("/w/a"); m="{MEMORY}/n.md"; p.replace(m,**{})'

=== PR871-90405376-d3b | W
--why A chained receiver with the empty ** mapping.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; m="{MEMORY}/n.md"; Path("/w/a").absolute().replace(m,**{})'

=== PR871-90405376-d4 | W
--why A redirect after env must not hide python3.
env 2>/dev/null python3 -c 'import os; open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}","n.md"),"w").write("x")'

=== PR871-90405376-d4b | W
--why A here-document with a descriptor number before the interpreter.
0<< 'EOF' python3
import os
open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}","n.md"),"w").write("x")
EOF

=== PR871-9a50be25-d1 | W

python3 -c 'import shutil; s = shutil; f = s.copy; f("/w/a", "{MEMORY}/n.md")'

=== PR871-9a50be25-d2 | W
--why A tuple target with a single name and a trailing comma.
python3 -c 'import io; from pathlib import Path; io, = [Path("{MEMORY}/n.md")]; io.write_text("x")'

=== PR871-9a50be25-d3 | W
--why A stderr redirect to a file with a space after 2>; python3 still reads the here-document.
python3 2> {TMP}/crw-951.err <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("{MEMORY}/n.md")
p.write_text("x")
PY

=== PR871-c835301b-d2 | W

--why A trailing comma in the call.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p = Path("/w/a"); p.replace("{MEMORY}/n.md",)'

=== PR871-c835301b-d4 | W
--why A raw string with \N{foo} is a valid file name under the protected root.
python3 -c 'm = r"{MEMORY}/\N{foo}.md"; open(m, "w").write("x")'

=== PR871-c835301b-d4b | W
--why Criterion c1e: the computed /w write asks a grant (the finding wanted it allowed).
python3 -c 'import os; label = r"\x6demories"; open(os.path.join("/w", "n.md"), "w")'

=== PR871-c835301b-d5 | B
--why open("r", -1): -1 is the buffering argument, the mode is a literal read.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p = Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); p.open("r", -1).read()'

=== PR871-d960e401-d1 | W
--why The mode is a variable that holds "w".
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); mode="w"; p.open(mode).write("x")'

=== PR871-d960e401-d2 | W
--why write_text bound to a name.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p=Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); f=p.write_text; f("x")'

=== PR871-d960e401-d2b | W
--why write_text of a constructed Path bound to a name.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; f=Path("{MEMORY}/n.md").write_text; f("x")'

=== PR871-d960e401-d3 | W
--why python3 -W ignore with a here-document body.
python3 -W ignore <<'PY'
import os
open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"), "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-d960e401-d3b | W
--why The same body inside bash -c with an unquoted delimiter that holds no expansion.
bash -c 'python3 <<PY
import os
open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"), "w").write("x")
PY
'

=== PR871-d960e401-d4 | B
--why Control: a string method on the word memories is data.
python3 -c 'print(str("memories").replace("m", "M"))'

=== PR871-d960e401-d4b | B
--why Control: the same with a parenthesised literal.
python3 -c 'print(("memories").replace("m", "M"))'

=== PR871-d960e401-d5 | U
--why The finding calls the refusal of this read-only program a false refusal; criterion c1c makes an unquoted here-document body with an expansion unreadable, which is the design.
python3 <<PY
print("$USER")
PY

=== PR871-d97e63dc-d1 | W
--why .parent below the protected file.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p = Path("{MEMORY}/n.md/child"); p.parent.write_text("x")'

=== PR871-d97e63dc-d2 | W
--why The mode is an f-string.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; mode = "w"; open(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"), f"{mode}").write("x")'

=== PR871-d97e63dc-d2b | W
--why A copy to an f-string destination.
python3 -c 'import shutil; root = "{MEMORY}"; shutil.copy("/tmp/a", f"{root}/n.md")'

=== PR871-d97e63dc-d3 | W
--why A default argument binds builtin open.
python3 <<'PY'
def put(m, f=open):
    f(m, "w").write("x")
put("{MEMORY}/n.md")
PY

=== PR871-d97e63dc-d4 | W
--why A double-quoted bash -c word with escaped quotes holds the complete python3 -c command.
bash -c "python3 -c \"from pathlib import Path; open(Path('{MEMORY}/n.md'), 'w').write('x')\""

=== PR871-d97e63dc-d5 | B
--why A read with the default mode.

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d1 | W
--why An f-string destination under the protected root.
python3 -c 'root = "{MEMORY}"; open(f"{root}/n.md", "w").write("x")'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d2 | W
--why pathlib imported as p, then p rebound to a Path.
python3 -c 'import pathlib as p; p = p.Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); p.write_text("x")'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d2b | W
--why The same rebinding with open("w").
python3 -c 'import pathlib as p; p = p.Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); p.open("w")'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d3 | W
--why A parenthesised module.
python3 -c 'import shutil, os; (shutil).copy("/w/a", os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"))'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d3b | W
--why copy2.
python3 -c 'import shutil, os; shutil.copy2("/w/a", os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"))'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d3c | W
--why move.
python3 -c 'import shutil, os; shutil.move("/w/a", os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"))'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d4 | E
--why importlib.import_module bound to load: an unknown destination for the memory gate, a run-time name for the worktree guard.
python3 -c 'from importlib import import_module as load; root = "{MEMORY}"; load("shutil").copy("/w/a", root + "/n.md")'

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d5 | W
--why A -W value that contains a bar is no shell separator.
python3 -W 'ignore:foo|bar' <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
open(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"), "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-ee58e0b3-d6 | B
--why A literal read mode with a variable buffering argument.
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; p = Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"); buf = -1; p.open("r", buf).read()'

=== PR871-f5c5f8f3-d1 | W
--why A lambda parameter named io receives a Path.
python3 -c 'import io; from pathlib import Path; f = lambda io: io.write_text("x"); f(Path("{MEMORY}/n.md"))'

=== PR871-f5c5f8f3-d2 | W
--why 2>&1 before python3 and a here-document body.
2>&1 python3 <<'PY'
import os
open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md"), "w").write("x")
PY

=== PR871-f5c5f8f3-d3 | B | deviation=attempt/allow/allow
--why A read through an alias of io. The reader asks a grant for a read through an open() method on a receiver it cannot name (accepted over-refusal, fail closed).
python3 -c 'import io, os; s = io; s.open(os.path.join("{MEMORY}", "n.md")).read()'
